_help: Hand-made fixes for stories the automatic rules got wrong. They apply on the next hourly run, also to stories already stored.
'match' and 'exclude' entries are pieces of a headline or link (not case-sensitive).
exclude: drop matching stories completely, e.g. "Winston-Salem".
override: change what a matching story is counted as. Any of cat (crime | corruption | development), types (list) and district can be set.
Crime types: Murder, Theft, Robbery, Assault, Cyber Crime, Women Safety, Narcotics.
Corruption types: Bribery Cases, Vigilance Raids & Searches, Disproportionate Assets, Officials Suspended, Arrests & Chargesheets, Other Corruption News.
